oneOf.description: Pause and wait for workers to release ownership.
Resume a paused or failed job.
Cancel and clean up partial data after workers stop.
Create a fresh download from the same URL.
Remove history and partial data, preserving completed files.
Rename an idle job's destination filename.

value.description: Rename an idle job's destination filename.

oneOf.description: Set queue priority, between -100 and 100.

Action.description: Queue control request; payload validation belongs to the service.

AddInput.description: Validated batch creation input, limited to 100 URLs.

allow_duplicates.description: Explicit permission to add duplicate URLs.

ApiError.description: Stable sanitized error response. Never contains submitted URLs or tokens.

Capture.description: Explicit one-download session handoff; values remain memory-only.

filename.description: Optional safe basename, never a path.

headers.description: Origin-scoped headers supplied for this download only.

sha256.description: Optional publisher hash, useful for automated integrity checks.

url.description: HTTP(S), or an explicitly selected hls+/dash+ source URL, without userinfo.

ConflictStrategy.description: Strategy for handling filename conflicts at the destination.

Direction.description: Peer transfer direction, independent from HTTP download semantics.

DownloadProgress.description: Progress information for a running download.

channel_capacity.description: Bounded channel capacity for internal events.

ewma_alpha.description: EWMA smoothing factor for throughput measurement (0.0–1.0).

fixed_concurrency.description: Fixed worker count for reproducible controls; null enables adaptation.

max_connections_total.description: Aggregate transport connections, including probes and redirected bodies.

min_segment_size.description:
Minimum segment size in bytes. Segments smaller than this will not be
split further.

retry_base_delay_ms.description: Base delay for exponential backoff in milliseconds.

traffic.description: Live payload limits and recurring queue/bandwidth windows.

write_buffer_size.description: Bounded buffer size for write operations in bytes.

oneOf.description: Job state changed.
Download progress updated.
Job completed successfully.
Job failed with an error.
Immutable file length and SHA-256 expected before publication.

sha256.description: Expected content digest; never a substitute for checking file bytes.

size.description: Expected content length, checked against aggregate policy.

oneOf.description: Explicit directory, including empty ones.

path.description: Exact NFC relative path; parents must also be explicit entries.

Entry.description:
Only regular files and directories can appear on the wire. Links, device
objects, permissions and sender absolute paths have no representation.

FileCredentials.description: Memory-only file login and an optional explicitly confirmed SSH fingerprint.

confirmed_host_key.description: Exact SHA256 fingerprint the user has verified and confirmed.

password.description: Password, retained only for this process session.

Hash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 commitment, not a credential or evidence of device trust.

IssueToken.description: Administration request. The maximum permitted lifetime is 90 days.

lifetime_secs.description: Positive expiry in seconds, at most 7,776,000.

IssuedToken.description: Returned only once over the authenticated admin connection.

token.description: Bearer credential; clients must treat as a secret.

Job.description: Display metadata and durable progress for one job.

protocol.description: Opaque protocol identifier; details are read through its app contract.

response_latency_ms.description: Time to response headers, including origin admission and redirects.

response_status.description: Last successful HTTP response status (session diagnostics).

url.description: Source URL explicitly entered by the user.

workers.description: Live transfer tasks; includes origin admission waits and retry backoff.

JobLimit.description: Per-job payload override. Removing an override restores the default rate.

bps.description: Positive bytes/second, or null for an unlimited job.

id.description: UUID of the job to limit.

JobRecord.description: Persistent metadata for a download job.

bytes_downloaded.description: Bytes downloaded so far (sum of completed segment bytes).

capture_id.description: Browser request id for durable idempotency, never a credential.

output_path.description: Final output path (after sanitization and conflict resolution).

partial_path.description: Path to the partial/temp file during download.

protocol.description: Opaque executor identifier. Core does not interpret protocol internals.

requires_session.description: Requires memory-only browser session headers; fail after session loss.

retry_count.description: Number of retry attempts so far.

updated_at.description: When the job was last updated.

use_server_filename.description: Use a sanitized server filename suggestion during the initial probe.

verified_sha256.description: Computed SHA-256 recorded before publication, for crash replay.

JobState.description:
State of a download job.

Transitions are validated by [`JobState::transition`].

Manifest.description:
Immutable ordered transfer metadata. Call validate after deserialization;
decode_frame and persistent admission both enforce that boundary.

entries.description: Entries sorted by exact UTF-8 path, parents before children.

MediaChoice.description: A manifest-advertised quality, audio or subtitle selection.

extension.description: Suggested output extension for the supported assembly path.

label.description: Quality, language and codec details reported by the manifest.

url.description: Explicit media source URL for this selection.

oneOf.description: Check the running desktop connection.
Enqueue one explicit transfer.

Operation.description: Operations available to browser clients. No arbitrary queue/admin access.

PeerApproval.description:
Fingerprint-confirmed trust update. The certificate is public material;
first approval uses no expected revision and replacement requires one.

PeerDecision.description: Compare-and-swap lifecycle decision for an admitted peer request.

destination.description: Receiver-selected directory, used only when accepting inbound data.

PeerDevice.description:
Unauthenticated DNS-SD address hint. `trusted` only means its advertised
fingerprint currently matches a local pin; TLS still proves the identity.

PeerIdentity.description: Public half of this installation's persistent peer identity.

certificate.description: Base64 DER certificate exchanged out of band during pairing.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint shown on the trusted native surface.

PeerRequest.description: Immutable peer offer and its current durable lifecycle.

destination.description: Local receiver destination; never populated for outbound requests.

PeerSend.description:
Manual-address outbound transfer. Source paths are consumed only by the
local native daemon and are never placed in the wire manifest.

PeerTrust.description: Public trust metadata returned to native management clients.

QuickPairing.description: Explicit native approval for one short-lived local browser session.

code.description: One-use approval code displayed only by the trusted native client.

RemoteIdentity.description:
Identifies the remote resource version for resume validation.

# Invariant

Resume is only permitted if the current remote identity matches the one
stored at download start. Strong ETags are required for `If-Range`; weak
ETags (`W/...`) are never used for byte-range resume.

etag.description: Strong ETag value, if provided. Weak ETags are excluded.

Request.description: Idempotency ID survives reconnects; protocol version is checked by Rust.

id.description: Canonical UUID generated for one operation.

Response.description: Sanitized acknowledgement; contains neither URL nor credentials.

job_id.description: Persisted job UUID for successful capture.

ok.description: Accepted by the desktop, not merely delivered to the host.

ScheduleWindow.description:
Recurring window. Start is inclusive, end exclusive; overnight windows
belong to their starting weekday. Overlapping rules use the stricter limit.

days.description: Monday=0 through Sunday=6; at least one distinct day.

end_minute.description: Local end minute, 0..1440; must differ from start.

global_bps.description: Optional aggregate cap applied in addition to the base cap.

queue_allowed.description: Null leaves queue behavior unchanged; false closes the queue.

Scope.description: Monotonic capability hierarchy; control cannot manage token credentials.

Segment.description: Segment diagnostic; byte offsets never exceed the engine's u64 bounds.

traffic.description: Shared runtime bandwidth and queue schedule policy.

Snapshot.description: Bounded snapshot page; clients replace pages after a missed update.

next.description: Next offset if more history exists.

revision.description: Monotonic session revision, serialized as a string.

State.description: Peer-specific lifecycle. Approval is distinct from device pairing.

Submit.description: Advanced single-job creation shared by embedded and daemon clients.

oneOf.description: Request-local file-protocol credentials; never stored in history.

destination.description: Absolute override; null uses service preferences.

TokenInfo.description: Public token metadata; contains no token or stored digest.

revoked.description: Whether this credential has been revoked.

TorrentFile.description: One metainfo file, independent of HTTP segment semantics.

bytes.description: File length; bounded below JavaScript's exact integer limit.

selected.description: Whether this file is selected for publication.

TorrentInput.description: Exactly one source must be supplied. Metainfo is base64, maximum 512 KiB decoded.

destination.description: Absolute destination override; null uses profile settings.

magnet.description: Magnet URI, no larger than 8192 bytes.

TorrentMetadata.description: Metadata preview, with no file creation or transfer admission.

info_hash.description: v1 info hash, verified during resolution.

trackers.description: Configured tracker endpoints, sanitized for display.

TorrentOptions.description: Torrent options persisted together with the job.

files.description: Null selects all files; otherwise a nonempty list of file indices.

initial_peers.description: Explicit initial peer addresses, maximum 32; useful for local/manual swarms.

oneOf.description: Discovery and socket settings.

seed_ratio.description: Maximum upload/download ratio; null adds no ratio restriction.

seed_seconds.description: Seconds to seed after completion; zero stops at completion. Null is explicit unlimited time.

TorrentPrivacy.description: Explicit peer discovery and network configuration.

bind_device.description: Supported on Linux/macOS only; interface name, not a filesystem path.

bootstrap_nodes.description: DHT bootstrap overrides; empty means no bootstrap network traffic.

dht.description: Enable public DHT discovery; off by default.

encryption.description: Only plaintext is supported by the pinned engine. Other values fail.

listen.description: Listening address; loopback by default. No UPnP mapping is requested.

local_discovery.description: Enable local multicast discovery; off by default.

peer_proxy.description: Optional SOCKS5 peer proxy, without embedded credentials.

pex.description: Exchange peer addresses; off by default.

activity.description: Resolving, downloading, paused, publishing, seeding, stopped or failed.

oneOf.description: Metadata once resolved.

peers.description: Serialized maintained-engine peer statistics; count remains bounded.

tracker_status.description: Tracker discovery state; does not imply successful announce telemetry.

uploaded_bytes.description: Actual live upload counter, or its last recorded value after stopping.

verified.description: Verified and durable pieces, never HTTP byte segments.

TrafficPolicy.description: Persistent payload policy shared by every backend. Null rates are unlimited.

job_limits.description: Explicit overrides, at most 128 unique job UUIDs.

per_job_bps.description: Default bytes/second for each job independently.

per_job_upload_bps.description: Independent default upload cap for each sharing job.

queue_allowed.description: Whether the queue runs outside matching queue windows.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, independent of the host's local zone.

upload_bps.description: Aggregate upload bytes/second for protocols that share files.

oneOf.description: Engine has changed; fetch an authoritative snapshot.

value.description: Engine has changed; fetch an authoritative snapshot.

oneOf.description: Initial subscription or dropped updates; discard stale local state.

Update.description: Bounded stream notifications. Clients must replace snapshots on Resync.
